name: primal_infeasible_psd
description: 2x2 SDP: max X_22 s.t. X_11 = -1, X >= 0. Infeasible because the diagonal of a PSD matrix must be >= 0, so X_11 = -1 admits no PSD feasible point. Tests the simplest primal-infeasibility detection via (tau,kappa): tau -> 0 with kappa bounded away from 0.
witness: Farkas y = (-1): sum_i y_i A_i = -E_11 (eigs -1,0) <= 0, and b^T y = (-1)*(-1) = 1 > 0. Hence no X >= 0 satisfies <A_1,X> = b_1 (Jansson-Chaykin-Keil 2007 Farkas alternative).
